context.body: Solomon’s Temple becomes the setting for a later king’s direct defilement.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Manasseh rebuilds high places, worships the sky’s army, practices occult rites, and installs an Asherah image in the house named to David and Solomon.
observations.label: Manasseh places an image in the house: action

observations.body: Judah is led into greater evil despite the conditional promise attached to the chosen house and city.
observations.label: Manasseh places an image in the house: response

observations.body: house · David and Solomon · put my name · if only they observe

payload.posture: Read 2 Kings 21:1–9 as later memory and aftermath evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The remembered promise contains its own obedience condition and cannot be used to shield the house from judgment.
payload.title: Manasseh places an image in the house
